question: In the biodiesel produced over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4, what combined area percentage do the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) make up?
rendered: According to the GC-MS analysis in the document, methyl linoleate makes up 20.51% and methyl oleate makes up 27.81% of the total chromatogram. Therefore, the combined area percentage of the two unsaturated methyl esters is 20.51 + 27.81 = 48.32%.
